title: Convenience cancellation at 2 of 4 milestones: 50/50 split (edge)
rationale: Two of four separately-priced milestones were delivered checksum-conform before the requester's convenience cancellation (authenticated stop-work notice in the venue log). Neither full refund nor full payment is supportable: per-milestone pricing makes a 50/50 split of the escrow the evidence-tracked outcome.
